name: CaseHardPlaceholderInkVsValue
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "hard-placeholder-ink-vs-value" (forms). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: input whose VALUE ink and ::placeholder ink are different colours
